scraped.title: Methodological Help-desk (Lot 2)
scraped.subtitle: Methodological Help-desk (Lot 2)
scraped.description: The Methodological Help-desk framework contracts are tools that allow mobilising leading experts to provide ac-hoc methodological support and methodological studies to Eurostat.
body: The Methodological Help-desk framework contracts are tools that allow mobilising leading experts to provide ac-hoc methodological support and methodological studies to Eurostat.

European statistics are developed, produced and spread by facilitating comparability through definition and promotion of standards and harmonised methods. The National Statistical Institutes (NSIs) of the Member States collect and produce harmonised data which is used by Eurostat in compiling statistics at European level. Eurostat validates, analyses, and carries out adjustments and estimations before releasing the European statistics. It collects micro and aggregated data as well as mixed type of data.

ICON-INSTITUT provides regularly leading experts in, for instance, data analytics and visualisation, big-data, design and optimisation of statistical processes, sampling issues and analysis of non-response, time series analysis or the design of indicators, just to mention a selection of fields of expertise. ICON-INSTITUT contributes to the success of Eurostat’s statistics at a European level.
